_comment: Maps garment lines to Easify option sets. Sets are located in option-sets.csv by option_set_title; set ids live in the CSV only. A set listed here but absent from the CSV is created on the next sync, cloned structurally from clone_from. A set in the CSV but not listed here is passed through untouched. WHY THIS IS LOAD-BEARING: live_temple_products() matches a live product to a set by EXACT EQUALITY against build_title(load_garment_config(garment), ...), so a renamed line must be mirrored in its garment config or the Temple dropdown detaches from it, silently. A populated set whose garment has no live products raises SystemExit, which is the guard against blanking a set on a bad catalogue read. A set flagged "paused": true passes through untouched because its line has no live products by design; a paused set that DOES have live products is itself an error.
